samples.summary: Text autofit-grow commit still writes a size-only frame patch, bypassing the new anchored-size contract for rotated text elements
samples.evidence: The diff establishes a repo-wide contract in `packages/slides/src/view/editor/interactions/resize.ts:117-118`: "Callers that write `w`/`h` on a rotated frame must go through this (or `resizeFrameWorld`) rather than patching size alone." An existing caller does exactly that: `packages/slides/src/view/editor/editor.ts:4420` commits `store.updateElementFrame(slideId, elementId, { h: targetH })` on text-edit exit. That path is only gated on `!ancestorHasTransform` (ancestor group transform, editor.ts:4417) — the element's OWN `frame.rotation` is not considered — so a rotated top-level textbox that autogrows keeps `x`/`y` fixed while its height changes, which moves the centre and shifts the painted box in world space: the exact defect #1039 fixed for the panel. The live ghost at `editor.ts:7420` (`{ ...el.frame, h: Math.max(MIN_TEXT_BOX_H, liveHeight) }`) has the same uncompensated shape. Fix belongs at the editor call site (route through the newly exported `resizeFrameToSize`), not in the diff's new code. Pre-existing behaviour, but it is the one remaining caller left outside the contract this change introduces.

samples.summary: anchoredFramePatch silently discards a caller-supplied x/y when the patch also carries w/h
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/format-panel/frame-patch.ts:25` returns `{ ...patch, x: next.x, y: next.y }`, so any `x`/`y` the caller put in the same patch is overwritten. Today no caller mixes them — `size-position-section.tsx:102` commits `{ w: px }`, `:118` commits `{ h: px }`, `:169` commits `{ rotation }`, and `index.tsx:144` translates with `{x,y}` only — so nothing is broken now. It is a trap for the next caller (e.g. a future "set X/Y/W/H at once" commit or a paste/arrange path routed through `commitFrame`), which would see its position silently ignored. Guarding (only inject x/y when the patch omits them, or throw) would make the contract explicit.

verdict.reason: All claimed elements verified. The contract text is present at resize.ts:115-118 ("Callers that write w/h on a rotated frame must go through this ... rather than patching size alone"), and resizeFrameToSize is exported (index.ts:254) with only the frontend panel path (frame-patch.ts:24) routed through it. The claimed bypassing caller exists verbatim: editor.ts:4420 writes a size-only patch `{ h: targetH }`, gated at 4417 solely on `h !== null && !ancestorHasTransform`. That flag is a world-vs-local divergence test (editor.ts:4294-4297) and is therefore false for a top-level rotated text element (world === local, as the comment at 4283 itself notes), so the element's own frame.rotation is never considered — not already-guarded. The path is reachable: buildEditTarget (editor.ts:7522-7533) applies no rotation gate for text elements (unlike the table paths at 3947/4166/4652/7579), and editingGrowApplicable (editor.ts:4303) only checks kind and ancestorHasTransform. The store applies no compensation either: memory.ts:708 is a plain frame spread-merge. Result: a rotated top-level textbox that autogrows keeps x/y fixed while h changes, moving the rotation centre and shifting the painted box — the same defect class the diff fixed for the panel. The live ghost at editor.ts:7418-7421 (fed from editor.ts:1540) has the same uncompensated shape. In-lane for blast-radius as a repo-wide contract/invariant with an unupdated caller; major since the site now yields a wrong world position. Pre-existing status does not exempt it under this rubric.
